overall: Honestly, most of these six are the same question in slightly different clothes, so the little details decide it for me. Call me out wins: clapping when the plane lands, still annoyed about my salad, checked their stories twice, stayed till 2am again. I'd screenshot half of those, and the jab lands on every option so I don't feel like there's a good-person answer. It slips a few times (the fun one on pay or passion, vows instead of marriage, self or others where the hobby answer gets nothing). Make it fun is a close second and owns my favorite line in the whole set, a week in my cart, plus someone actually likes vacuuming, which I'm sending to my partner. Scenario director has great concrete moments (late-night talks, every single review, keep the money for us) and is the fairest on the wedding stuff, but it borrows a lot of the same lines. Cozy quest is clean with a couple of cute gamer winks (daily tasks), but 'the right move is' and 'not something to get close to' made me feel judged, and I play Love and Deepspace, so I noticed. Be kind is clear and respectful and it's the one I'd want for caregiving and AI companions, but I'd never send it to anyone. The Oracle is last: the options are fine, but 'the cards see your part done' and 'your past card' made me read twice, and a fortune-teller intro on every single question gets old by question five.
